encoder_method_note:
The skyline's 18 buildings are plain rects whose `height` attributes are the letter positions of the message multiplied by 10 (A=10, B=20, … Z=260), so p=160, a=10, s=190, o=150, and so on, read left to right. Word breaks are encoded structurally: each word is its own `<g>` block, and blocks are separated by wider 50px "street" gaps instead of the 10px gaps used within a word. Dividing each height by 10 and mapping to A1Z26 yields PASO / A / PASO / SE / VA / LEJOS; the mirrored water reflection via `<use>` simply repeats the same data.
